messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error loading F2 GBS results
parts:
These are warnings not errors; you can ignore them, but they are indicating potential problems.

1: If "U" is intended to indicate missing data, you can just ignore this first warning, or you could revise your call to read.cross to include na.strings="U", or something like na.strings=c("U", "-", "NA"), and the warning will not be issued.

2: We need marker locations in cM rather than bp. Sometimes people provide bp locations, which can cause problems, so if some marker locations are at values > 1000, we give a warning message.

karl



On Nov 8, 2012, at 1:11 PM, Ashwani <ashwan...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Hello,
> I'm trying to make denovo linkage map using GBS data.
> after i load the data in rqtl, i'm getting the following warning message:
>
> > mapthis <- read.cross("csv", "/data/GBS/SB/rqtl", "mapthis.csv", estimate.map=FALSE)
> --Read the following data:
> 88 individuals
> 3728 markers
> 1 phenotypes
> --Cross type: f2
> Warning messages:
> 1: In read.cross.csv(dir, file, na.strings, genotypes, estimate.map, :
> The following unexpected genotype codes were treated as missing.
> |U|
>
> 2: In summary.cross(cross) :
> Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
> (Perhaps it is in basepairs?)
>
>
> Shalli ignore the summary.cross(cross) error? or this needs to be fixed? le me know how to fix this.
>
>
>
> Best Regards,
> Ashwani
>
>
